description: Java class defining an immutable StreamAck message used for acknowledging stream elements, including methods for creating success/failure acknowledgments, JSON serialization/deserialization, and internal status enumeration.

classes.name: StreamAck
classes.description: Immutable class representing an acknowledgment message for stream elements, encapsulating element ID and status, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: StreamAck.Status
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible statuses for stream acknowledgments: SUCCESS, FAILURE, UNKNOWN, with method to parse from String.

methods.name: getElementId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the element being acknowledged.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Factory method to create a successful acknowledgment for a given element ID.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Factory method to create a failure acknowledgment for a given element ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Private helper to instantiate a StreamAck with provided element ID and status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StreamAck instance to a JSON value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StreamAck instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare StreamAck instances.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the StreamAck object.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Status enum from its String representation.
